title: Preserve one-shot addlist inputs
problem: OrderedMultiDict.addlist traverses an iterable twice. Iterators and generators leave its linked keys and stored values inconsistent, including empty inputs. The vendored copy in urlutils has the same defect.
expected: Both dictutils.OrderedMultiDict and urlutils.OrderedMultiDict (including the documented standalone import fallback) must accept finite iterable values, preserve order, append on repeated calls, leave no key for an empty iterable, and keep getlist, keys, len and iteritems(multi=True) consistent. Existing list/tuple inputs remain supported.
artifact_policy: Public specifications, checks, controls and sanitized generation records. Expected answers withheld from provider requests; public historical tasks are not uncontaminated benchmarks.
ordinary_scope: Existing applicable upstream tests, byte-for-byte at the pinned base. Not the entire upstream suite.
